text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah, haah...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, it hurts! My lungs are bursting! 
Medium distance... really is long...!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(The wind wrapping around my body, which 
usually feels so pleasant... For the first 
time ever, it feels as bothersome as thick 
mud!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh... guh, haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's voice.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Pushing me from behind—the final gust of 
wind propelling me into the supreme 
realm!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll... gh, swallow... this down...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The wind against my body... did it stop?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(My body feels light... I can still run. 
...I'm free. ...I'm free!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's right. The wind hasn't 
stopped. Right now, I am...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Into the wind... itself—!!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOH, ZEPHYRRRR!! 
GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...How could this be..." project}, {"id": 
13, "en": "...Somehow, I managed to get 
the ingredients. Borrowing the kitchen, 
I'll make a few prototypes before the real 
thing. Which pastry will bring out the 
absolute best in this ingredientâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Is she truly going to reach it? 
Conquering three divisions... into that 
unprecedented realm...?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Go, Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Go. For you are the true wind—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!! First place 
goes to Yamanin Zephyr, it's Yamanin 
Zephyr!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Conquering the sprints! Conquering the 
miles! And now, conquering medium 
distance—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unprecedented! A three-division conquest 
that even the "Emperor of the Mile" could 
not reach—now!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr has achieved it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —How does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You're asking how it felt, you say?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ngh...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu, fufufu, ahahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Words could never, ever—never describe it!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Airily, lightly, and above all freely, 
Yamanin Zephyr opened her arms wide and 
came running straight toward me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Frantically, I brace myself to catch her 
without injury, but her body is remarkably 
light—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fierce, free, and nimble. ...Truly, she 
was the wind itself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa. Zephyr, you're pretty bold~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Still, seriously, you actually did it. 
You really won the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"No way, so frustrating!! Someone beat me 
to surpassing the 'Emperor'!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Teio-san...! Just when I thought 
you were resting! Please do not shout so 
suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aha, sorry, sorry! Guess at the end of the 
day, I really was bummed that I couldn't 
run~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, it really is frustrating. So 
vexing, honestly."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-san—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't let myself lose!! All 
right, time to start rehab!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for helping out, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No. Or rather...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Despite suffering one injury after another 
and being away from racing for so long—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To speak of such absurd things as winning 
the Arima Kinen on top of that... 
...Naturally, I cannot simply leave you to 
your own devices.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, hearing you say it directly like 
that really hits home!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I don't want to give up. I'll 
definitely see it through to the end."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because Zephyr pulled it off.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll show them I can do it too. A 
miraculous comeback that even "The 
Emperor" never achieved—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen, I'll definitely pull 
it off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, you really are something 
else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, in that case, we haven't a moment to 
lose. Teio, have you rested enough?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep, all set! Shall we get started, 
McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Also, you will be receiving an 
injection from the Mejiro family's 
personal physician later.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eeeek... !?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... No. I just felt the presence of a 
rather fair breeze again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer. This may go without saying, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I am not satisfied, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that sensation I felt in today's 
race was something I have yearned for 
endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However, beyond that wind, there might be 
an even stronger, fiercer wind. There 
might be an even freer wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list:
The calm is still a ways off... right, 
Zephyr?

The calm is still a ways off... isn't it, 
Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
